card.name: Inside surnames like Müller and Millington
card.fires_on: Partway through a person's surname, on pieces like Mull, Mill, Ell, Goll or Ell after the first letters, as in Müller, Milligan, Gellman or Ellery. Seen in author names, citations and quotes.

modes.label: Surname piece in a quote
modes.description: The piece Mull, Goll or Woll falls inside the surname of a person being quoted.
modes.example: "Jerry is really an intrepid explorer, says Kal<< Mull>>er, author of Underwater Indonesia.

modes.label: Surname piece in citations
modes.description: Mill or Ell appears inside an author's name in a reference list or byline.

card.plain: It fires in the middle of a surname such as Müller or Milligan, mostly in author names and citations.
